Kedarkantha Trek

THE TREK

About the Kedarkantha Trek

Kedarkantha is one of the most loved summit treks in Uttarakhand. Starting from the village of Sankri, the trail climbs through dense pine and oak forests, crosses a few streams and opens into wide meadows, with traditional shepherd log huts along the way.

You camp beside the serene, ice-edged waters of Juda Ka Talab, spend a night at base camp, then start before dawn for the summit at 3,810 m (12,500 ft). From the top you see sunrise and a sweeping 360-degree panorama of Swargarohini, Bandarpoonch and the Yamunotri–Gangotri ranges. A certified trek leader, guides, cooks and porters look after the group throughout.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Enchanting pine trails — dense, sun-dappled oak and pine forests on a winding mountain trail.

Juda Ka Talab — camp beside the serene, ice-edged lake.

Summit push — a rewarding climb to 3,810 m (12,500 ft) for sunrise.

360-degree panorama — Swargarohini, Bandarpoonch and the Yamunotri–Gangotri ranges.

Scenic journey to Sankri — a mountain drive of about 220 km from Dehradun.

Meadows and shepherd huts — open green stretches and traditional log huts on the trail.

Expert team — a certified trek leader, guides, cooks and porters.

Safety first — first aid, a medical kit, oxygen cylinders and stretchers on the trek.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Pickup: Early pickup from Dehradun Railway Station between 6:30 and 7:00 AM.
  • Drive: A scenic 10-hour, 220 km drive in a Tempo Traveller, climbing steadily towards the mountains.
  • Arrival: Reach Sankri (6,400 ft / 1,951 m) and settle into your stay between 5:00 and 5:30 PM.
  • Meals: Vegetarian dinner is provided.
  • Night: Overnight stay at Sankri.
  • Start: Begin the trek between 8:00 and 8:30 AM from Sankri (6,400 ft).
  • Climb: Ascend to Juda Ka Talab (9,100 ft) through dense pine forests and under maple trees.
  • Trail: Cross a few streams before the path opens into beautiful meadows.
  • Arrival: Reach the campsite between 1:00 and 1:30 PM.
  • Meals: Vegetarian breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner.
  • Night: Overnight stay in a tent at Juda Ka Talab.
  • Start: Begin the trek between 8:00 and 8:30 AM.
  • Climb: Trek from Juda Ka Talab (9,100 ft) up to Kedarkantha Base Camp (11,250 ft).
  • Trail: A forest path under canopying oak trees, open meadows and traditional shepherd log huts.
  • Arrival: Reach base camp early, between 11:00 and 11:30 AM, with time to rest and acclimatise.
  • Meals: Vegetarian breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner.
  • Night: Overnight stay in a tent at base camp.
  • Pre-dawn start: Set off between 2:00 and 2:30 AM for the summit push, about 6 km and 7 hours in all.
  • Summit: Reach Kedarkantha Summit (12,500 ft) around 6:00 to 6:30 AM, in time for sunrise.
  • Views: Enjoy 360-degree views of Swargarohini, Bandarpoonch and the neighbouring ranges.
  • Descent: Head back down to Juda Ka Talab (8,900 ft).
  • Meals: Vegetarian breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner.
  • Night: Overnight stay in a tent at Juda Ka Talab.
  • Descent: Start between 5:30 and 6:00 AM and walk down to Sankri (6,400 ft), arriving around 9:30 to 10:00 AM.
  • Drive: Board the Tempo Traveller for the drive down to Dehradun (2,100 ft).
  • Meals: Vegetarian breakfast, lunch and snacks.
  • Drop: Reach Dehradun station between 6:00 and 7:00 PM.
  • Onward travel: Please book onward travel back home for after 9:00 PM.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Not included in your package

  • Backpack carrying (offloading) charges of ₹250 per bag per day
  • Personal expenses
  • Anything not explicitly listed in the inclusions
